Introduction

Yoon Jin-young, better known by his stage name ASH ISLAND and formerly known as Clloud, is a South Korean rapper and singer. He first gained attention as a contestant on season 2 of Mnet’s High School Rapper, where he finished in 4th place. In November 2018, he signed under The Quiett’s sub-label Ambition Musik, marking the start of his professional career.

ASH ISLAND officially debuted on March 22, 2019 with the release of his first full-length album Ash, which established his signature sound characterized by husky vocals, melodic rap, and emotional lyricism. Since then, he has built a strong presence in the Korean hip-hop scene and gained recognition for both his solo releases and collaborations with other prominent artists.

On July 7, 2024, Yoon announced his marriage to Korean-Japanese rapper Chanmina, as well as her pregnancy with their first child. The couple welcomed their daughter on November 1, 2024.
